notes.title: Patch 1.0.4: Russian Language Now Available + Key Bug Fixes and Improvements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We’re excited to bring you another update for [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b], and we have some great news: [b]Russian language support[/b] is now available in the game! We’ve been working hard to ensure that Wéko can be enjoyed by an even broader audience, and we’re thrilled to extend this support to our Russian-speaking players.

In addition to the new language option, we've made several important adjustments and bug fixes to improve your gameplay experience:

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Russian Language Added: You can now play Wéko The Mask Gatherer in Russian, making the adventure accessible to even more players worldwide.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Faster Stamina Regen After Sprinting: We've adjusted the stamina system so that after sprinting, your stamina will now start regenerating more quickly.
[*] Overall Stamina Regen Boost: We’ve increased the overall stamina regeneration rate by 20%, allowing you to stay in the action longer without needing to rest as much.
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Life Mask Healing Fix: We resolved an issue where the Life Mask would continue healing if you put it on and took it off during a pause. This behavior should now be corrected.
[*] Weapon Duplication Fix: We've fixed a bug that was causing weapon duplication under certain conditions, ensuring fairer gameplay.
[/list]
We’re continuously working to make Wéko The Mask Gatherer the best experience possible, and your feedback is crucial to that process. Please keep sharing your thoughts and experiences with us.

[url=https://discord.gg/Tx4MGJE6Mr] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/c88fc8ab0979653a37fec5e73ec94ef248dda7be.jpg[/img] [/url]

As always, we’d love to see you in our Discord community where you can connect with other players, share your thoughts, and stay updated on the latest developments.

Thank you for your support!

Best regards,
SIRO GAMES

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Update: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Following the initial feedback and our recent 1.0.2 patch, we’ve continued to listen to your thoughts and have made further improvements to [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b]. Your input has been invaluable in helping us refine the game, and we’re excited to share the details of our 1.0.3 patch:

[b]Community-Requested Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Pause Menu:[/u] We heard your feedback about the lack of a pause menu, and we're happy to announce that [b]the game will now pause when you access the Inventory.[/b] This should give you the break you need during intense gameplay moments.
[*] [u]Inventory and UI Enhancements:[/u] Many of you mentioned that the UI in the inventory and the text size was a bit small, particularly on the SteamDeck and other screens. [b]We've updated the inventory interface and increased the text size for both tooltips and the inventory[/b], making it more readable and user-friendly.
[*] [u]Credits in Map Menu:[/u] We've added the Credits to the Map menu, making it easier for players to view the game's credits at any time.
[/list]
[b]Number Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Spear Damage Boost: [/u]We've improved the damage of the spear, increasing it by 5 points for each attack in a combo as well as for the jump attack, giving you a more powerful weapon to wield in your adventures.
[*] [u]Stamina Regeneration:[/u] Previously, when shielding, your stamina regeneration was at 1/4 of its normal speed. We’ve upgraded it to 1/2, allowing you to regenerate stamina faster while shielding.
[*] [u]FPS and Stamina Regeneration:[/u] We've fixed an issue where FPS would affect stamina regeneration. Now, stamina regen is consistent regardless of FPS, ensuring a fair experience across all devices.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Lock-On Targeting: [/u]Some players reported issues with the lock-on system where it was impossible to target enemies correctly. We’ve added a bunch of code to prevent this problem.
[*] [u]Bombs & Stalagmites:[/u] Fixed an issue where bombs from Cinos were incorrectly hitting stalagmites. This should no longer happen, ensuring fairer gameplay.
[*] [u]Final Boss Fix:[/u] Addressed a bug that caused the final boss to kick players into the air before striking, preventing unexpected deaths and making the battle more consistent.
[*] [u]Achievement Fix:[/u] Some players encountered a bug where the Steam Achievement for "The Best Racer" wasn’t triggered. Now, if you talk to the NPC responsible for this quest again after beating the record of 22 seconds, he should trigger the achievement properly.
[*] [u]Narcissio 2D Cinematic:[/u] The Narcissio 2D cinematic was missing in previous versions, but we've now added it back into the game, restoring the complete storytelling experience.
[/list]

[b]Collisions:[/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Improved Collision Detection:[/u] We've improved and removed some strange collisions that were causing issues in various parts of the game.
[/list]

We want to thank you for your continued support and for sharing your experiences with us. Your feedback is invaluable, and we hope these improvements enhance your journey with Wéko. 

[url=https://discord.gg/Tx4MGJE6Mr] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/c88fc8ab0979653a37fec5e73ec94ef248dda7be.jpg[/img] [/url]

As always, if you encounter any more bugs or have further suggestions, please join our Discord community and let us know. We're committed to making Wéko The Mask Gatherer the best experience possible.

Best regards,
SIRO GAMES

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 Update: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been 1 week since the release of [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b], and we are thrilled with the overall feedback. We've been listening to the community and have made several improvements based on your feedback. Here are the details of our second patch:

[u]Gameplay Improvements:[/u]

[list]
[*] We heard the community and players didn't like the "soft stun" when Wéko was hit by an enemy. Now, [b]when Wéko gets hit by an enemy, he won't be soft stunned[/b] and will be able to attack back, protect himself with his shield, or roll out.
[/list]

[u]Bug Fixes:[/u]

[list]
[*] Solved a bug where tombs in the graveyard could soft lock the player because the door wouldn't open.
[*] Solved a bug where Envy could be invisible.
[/list]

[u]Collisions:[/u]

[list]
[*] Solved a collision issue in Galto Village that made it difficult for the boomerang to hit the lamps.
[*] The counter-attack from Scavenger Chef is now better correlated with its VFX.
[*] Fixed a collision issue where the Gorifiki Kameha could kill from behind.
[/list]

[u]Number Adjustments:[/u]

[list]
[*] Increased the number of scavengers from 3 to 4 in front of the Oracle in Dark Forest Depth.
[*] Increased the explosion damage from Red Rocks from 50 to 55.
[*] Increased the base damage of the boomerang from 10 to 12.5 (Damage of the boomerang with the Hurricane Relic Mask remains the same at 25 DMG).
[*] Boss nerfs:

[olist]
[*] Ragorus: HP reduced from 600 to 550.
[*] Gorifiki: HP reduced from 700 to 650.
[*] Cinos: HP reduced from 800 to 750.
[*] Envy: HP reduced from 1500 to 1300.
[/olist]

[/list]
[u]Pathing Improvements:[/u]

[list]
[*] Solved various small pathing problems.
[/list]


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Please keep sharing your experiences and suggestions with us. We hope these improvements enhance your adventure with Wéko!

For any further bugs or issues, please join our Discord community :
[url=https://discord.gg/Tx4MGJE6Mr] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/c88fc8ab0979653a37fec5e73ec94ef248dda7be.jpg[/img] [/url]

This is the place where you can report bugs, and we will work on them as soon as possible.

Best regards,
SIRO GAMES

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Update: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been 3 days since the release of [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer, and we're thrilled with the overall feedback[/b]. 

However, we've heard and listened to some issues that players encountered during the first hour of the game. We've reworked the pacing in the Lone Beach area, making it more interesting and reflective of the later game.

We’re also happy to see that the demo was played by so many players. For now, we will be removing the demo until further notice.

Here are the details of the patch:

[list]
[*] Improvement of the Pacing in the Lone Beach: Added new enemy areas to enhance the gameplay experience.
[*] Fixed Camera Lock Bug: Resolved an issue that made it impossible to lock the camera on some interactible lamps.
[*] Door of the Tomb Bug Fix: Addressed a bug that prevented the door of the tomb from opening.
[*] Mini Boss Chest Spawn Issue: Fixed an issue where the mini boss chest wasn't spawning if the player died at the same time as the mini boss.
[*] Typos Correction: Corrected several typos.
[*] General Improvements and Small Debugs: Fixed issues such as floating grass and double sound effects in the same location.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Please keep sharing your experiences and suggestions with us. We hope these improvements enhance your adventure with Wéko!

[b]For any further bugs or issues, please join our Discord community[/b] 

[url=https://discord.gg/Tx4MGJE6Mr] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/c88fc8ab0979653a37fec5e73ec94ef248dda7be.jpg[/img] [/url]
This is the place where you can report bugs, and we will work on them as soon as possible.

Best regards,

SIRO GAMES

notes.title: This is Wéko The Mask Gatherer in a Nutshell! 🌰
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/033ee48b22ff160e2674cae171e6f508c2bd6683.png[/img]
Hey there, friends!

As [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b] will finally release on PC in 2 days, we thought we'd drop a little summary of what you can expect from the game we have worked on for the last four years.

We've really enjoyed making the game and are feeling extremely proud of the final result. We are confident that you will have a great time with Wéko and his exciting adventure. Anyways, we think it’s a good idea to lay out the features of Wéko The Mask Gatherer openly and honestly, so you know what to expect before spending your hard-earned money.

Here you go, this is [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b] in a nutshell:

[list]
[*] A single-player, action-adventure game inspired by classic 3D platformers and RPGs like Zelda (OOT), Souls-like, and Spyro.
[*] Collectible masks that grant Wéko unique abilities and powers to aid him on his quest. You can specialize Wéko, whether you prefer distance or melee combat, and build him accordingly.
[*] Engaging combat mechanics that challenge your skills while offering a [b]cozy gaming experience[/b].
[*] A vast and beautiful fantasy world filled with colorful characters, intriguing puzzles, and detailed environments to explore.
[*] An emotional story centered around Wéko’s journey, filled with heartwarming moments and challenging trials.
[*] Around 8-12 hours of gameplay to complete the main storyline, with plenty of side quests and secrets to uncover.
[*] Full controller support with customizable controls to enhance your gameplay experience.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843796/78616db51a17de7399c17b6f0878f9213798f8c3.png[/img]
That’s it! That’s [b]Wéko The Mask Gatherer[/b]. Should we be lucky enough that you deem it worthy, we really hope you enjoy playing it as much as we’ve enjoyed making it for you!

See you soon for the release, friends!

SIRO GAMES
